requisitionList.Title: Deputy Program Manager
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Deputy Program Manager (DPM) is responsible for the day-to-day program governance and business operations of SOCO. The DPM will ensure disciplined execution of Oracle's commitments, provide operational leadership across the projects, and support the Program TPM in successful program delivery.

requisitionList.Title: Solution Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Oracle HCM Solutions
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Do you enjoy inspiring people as much as solving business challenges?
Oracle is looking for a passionate Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer to join our HCM team and help organizations transform the future of HR.
This is more than a technical pre-sales role- it's an opportunity to become a trusted advisor, a compelling presenter, and a strategic partner to HR leaders. If you enjoy engaging with people, presenting innovative solutions, and influencing decision-makers, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Lead and collaborate across diverse, matrixed teams to achieve PMT objectives 
  • Support the TPM, in the overall execution and delivery of the program.
